html.htmlText:
Enjoy staying in the private, cozy hideaway in vibrant Northeast Portland. This studio is a great place to relax after exploring all that Portland has to offer.

Walk down the street to visit local coffeehouses, restaurants, breweries and more! Or hop on your bike to visit nearby neighborhoods like Alberta, Hawthorne and Belmont.

The studio is also dog-friendly! We have two dogs who will also be using the fully fenced in back yard, so please let us know if your pup needs some space.

The space is a fully-detached 600 sqft studio that has all the amenities you could ask for. You’re also welcome to hang out on the small deck outside the space and your furry friends are welcome to enjoy the fenced-in backyard. Our pups would love to play with them too!

There is a fully-stocked kitchenette including an air fryer / toaster, microwave, hotplate, Keurig and more! Both the kitchen and bathroom are newly redone.

The space features a queen-sized bed and a twin-sized rollaway to easily sleep 3, or 4 if someone sleeps on the couch. We also have Android and iPhone chargers available to ensure you can stay connected.

The kitchen table easily seats four for a meal, plus is a great work-from-home spot. We made sure wifi is top-notch to make sure you can do as much work as needed while you’re here!

The living room has a Smart TV, Wii, and board games for your enjoyment, plus a comfy couch and plenty of blankets so you can curl up with a great TV show or book to unwind from your day.

Our pups are both extremely friendly, and get along with all people and dogs. One of them is a pitbull which we’ve found some people to be less comfortable with, so just worth knowing that in case it is a factor for your group. She is the most loved and most loving girl on the block!
Guests will have access to fully fenced backyard and detached studio behind the main house.
